IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senators Benton and Berkey; by request of Secretary of State

Bill.BriefDescription: Conforming legal notice broadcast requirements to current practice.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to broadcast of legal notices; amending RCW65.16.130 and 65.16.150; and repealing RCW 65.16.140.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 65.16.130 and 1961 c 85 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any official of the state or any of its political subdivisions whois required by law to publish any notice required by law may supplementpublication thereof by radio or television broadcast or both when, inhis judgment, the public interest will be served thereby: PROVIDED,That the time, place, and nature of such notice only be read or shownwith no reference to any person by name then a candidate for politicaloffice, ((and that such broadcasts shall be made only by duly employedpersonnel of the station from which such broadcasts emanate,)) and thatnotices by political subdivisions may be made only by stations situatedwithin the county of origin of the legal notice.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 65.16.150 and 1961 c 85 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Written documentation of proof of publication of legal notice or p. 1 SB 6542notice of event must be provided by the radio or television ((broadcastshall be by affidavit of the manager, an assistant manager or a programdirector of the)) station broadcasting the ((same)) notice.
RCW 65.16.140 (Broadcaster to retain copy ortranscription) and 1961 c 85 s 2 & 1951 c 119 s 2 are each repealed.
